subject: [PATCH v4 7/8] mm/page_alloc: retry alloc_contig_pages() when the zonelist is rebuilt

reviews.author: Vlastimil Babka (SUSE)
reviews.summary: Provided a Reviewed-by tag, indicating that the code looks good to them. However, they may have additional comments or concerns that are not yet visible in this thread.

2026-10-28.patch_summary: This patch series aims to improve the handling of gigantic hugetlb pages in the page allocator by introducing a retry mechanism when the zonelist is rebuilt. The current implementation has issues with allocating contiguous pages, leading to incorrect placement of gigantic pages in ZONE_MOVABLE. This patch specifically addresses this issue by checking the zonelist update sequence before using each zone and restarting the walk if it changed.
